description: Defines the interface and API for low-level inter-processor mailbox communication (IPM) in Zephyr OS, including callback types, API structures, and function prototypes.

methods.name: ipm_send
methods.description: Attempts to send a message over the specified IPM device, returning status codes based on success or failure.

methods.name: ipm_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to handle incoming IPM messages.

methods.name: ipm_max_data_size_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum data size that can be sent in a single IPM message.

methods.name: ipm_max_id_val_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum message ID value supported by the IPM device.

methods.name: ipm_set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables inbound IPM channels and callbacks.

methods.name: ipm_complete
methods.description: Signals the completion of an asynchronous IPM command.
